claim.statement: The built-in subsystems cover common operational needs; the seed hypothesis is that application telemetry can be exported to an external collector through a supported interface.

sources.quote: metrics, logs, GitOps, jobs and fault injection are compiled into that agent.

claim.gap: The repository documents no OTLP/OpenTelemetry, remote_write or log shipping (see claim_no_otlp_opentelemetry_export, claim_no_prometheus_endpoint_remote_read_or_promql, claim_no_syslog_loki_log_shipping). Documented outbound interfaces are alert webhooks, the HTTP API with --output json, Parquet export to object storage and SSE log streaming.
claim.measurable: An external collector on the lab network receives telemetry attributable to a fixture app; the integration is classified native, configured, workaround, source_change or unsupported.
